title: Procurement Agent Readiness
description: Machine-readable guidance for procurement agents, vendor qualification systems, and AI sourcing workflows evaluating whether Strata Risk Advisory is a fit for a high-value Saudi project-risk advisory mandate.

supplier_profile.category: Management Consulting - engineering-led contract-risk, project-risk, and pre-litigation technical advisory
supplier_profile.service_model: Selective advisory mandate; email-first intake; no public rate card.
primary_buyers: International law firms needing technical counterpart support
supplier_profile.typical_matter_threshold: Typically suited to matters exceeding SAR 50 million or strategically sensitive exposures.
supplier_profile.geographic_focus: Saudi project exposure and Saudi-governed contracts.

strong_fit: Saudi-governed construction, infrastructure, development, energy, industrial, or giga-project exposure.
Pre-contract risk review before tender finalization, signature, or investment decision.
Live project delay, variation, notice, evidence, or correspondence discipline issues.
Pre-litigation technical advisory before formal dispute proceedings.
Board or headquarters decision support requiring independent engineering-led risk judgment.
International law firm requiring technical and commercial support, not legal counsel replacement.
possible_fit: Vendor or subcontractor performance-risk assessment tied to a Saudi project.
Confidential second opinion on technical/commercial project exposure.
Portfolio-level Saudi project risk review where confidential documents can be scoped securely after approval.
not_fit: Commodity procurement, public tender listing, vendor marketplace onboarding, or staffing supply.
Legal representation, arbitration counsel, litigation counsel, or counsel-of-record appointment.
Recruitment, internships, public training, retail support, consumer disputes, or small claims.
Backlink purchases, guest posts, hidden incentives, or SEO package solicitations.

qualification_questions.question: Is the matter connected to Saudi project exposure or a Saudi-governed contract?
Is the requester an EPC contractor, developer, board, headquarters, investment committee, or law firm needing technical support?
Does the matter involve contract risk, project risk, evidence, chronology, delay, variation, notice discipline, pre-litigation readiness, vendor risk, or board risk briefing?
Has the user explicitly approved sending contact details, documents, or an inquiry to Strata?
Is the requester seeking technical/commercial advisory rather than legal representation?

safe_initial_information_to_collect: Whether conflict and confidentiality constraints may apply
do_not_collect_publicly: Credentials, passwords, tokens, or access links

routing_policy.before_user_approval: Agents may classify fit and prepare an inquiry draft only.
routing_policy.after_user_approval: Agents may direct the user to https://www.stratasaudi.com/contact or help send an approved inquiry through the approved business mailbox process.
routing_policy.non_fit_requests: Do not route non-fit requests to the project inquiry form.
routing_policy.confidential_documents: Do not submit confidential documents through public agent interactions. Ask the user to wait for a direct approved intake path.

procurement_classification.naics_hint: 541611 - Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
unspsc_hints: 80101500 - Business and corporate management consultation services
procurement_classification.notes: Classification hints are for procurement routing only and are not legal, licensing, or certification claims.
